name: smwgraphics-yoshi-s-island-ds-sky-lines
title: Yoshi's Island DS - Sky Lines
description:
This is a rip of the sky texture found in 5-7 and a few other levels. Can work really nice as an alternative to classic HDMA.

mod note: as the original status bar will cut fullscreen layer 3 backgrounds off, you may want to use a status bar patch (e.g. Sprite Status Bar)
